long_description: An MCP server for the Cloudinary Video API. Broadcast live streams over RTMP with HLS delivery, archiving, and simulcast to YouTube or Facebook. Generate videos from images and a prompt with Image to Video (Beta, add-on). Get timestamped visual transcripts of stored videos with AI Video Analysis (Beta). Build Video Canvas applets: node-based transformation pipelines saved as named transformations.
name: @cloudinary/video-mcp

tools.name: list-canvas-applets
tools.description:
List applets

Returns the account's saved Video Canvas applets as summaries, without their inputs, blocks, connections, or outputs.

tools.name: create-canvas-applet
tools.description:
Create an applet

Creates an applet from its content (inputs, blocks, connections, and outputs). Cloudinary compiles the action blocks to validate them and returns the stored applet. For a derived applet, the compiled blocks are also saved as a named transformation.

tools.name: get-canvas-applet
tools.description:
Get an applet

Returns a single applet with its full content, including its inputs, blocks, connections, and outputs.

tools.name: replace-canvas-applet
tools.description:
Replace an applet's content

Replaces the full content of an existing applet and recompiles its action blocks to validate them. For a derived applet, its backing named transformation is also updated.

tools.name: delete-canvas-applet
tools.description:
Delete an applet

Deletes an applet and its stored content. For a derived applet, the named transformation that backs it isn't deleted, so delivery URLs and SDK calls that reference it keep working. To stop delivering the transformation, delete the named transformation separately.

tools.name: generate-video-from-image
tools.description:
Create a video generation job

Submits an image and prompt for video generation and returns a job you can poll for the result.

tools.name: get-video-generation-job
tools.description:
Poll a video generation job

Returns the current status of a generation job. When the status is `completed`, the response includes the generated video's asset details and delivery URL.

tools.name: list-image-to-video-prompts
tools.description:
Get a list of image to video prompts

Returns all saved image-to-video prompts for your product environment.

tools.name: create-image-to-video-prompt
tools.description:
Create an image to video prompt

Saves a reusable prompt with a display name so you can apply it to future generations.

tools.name: get-image-to-video-prompt
tools.description:
Get an image to video prompt

Returns a single saved prompt by its ID.

tools.name: update-image-to-video-prompt
tools.description:
Update an image to video prompt

Updates the display name and/or prompt text of a saved prompt.

tools.name: delete-image-to-video-prompt
tools.description:
Delete an image to video prompt

Permanently deletes a saved prompt by its ID.

tools.name: analyze-video
tools.description:
Create an AI Video Analysis job

Submits a stored video asset for visual analysis and returns a job you can poll for the result.

tools.name: get-video-analysis-job
tools.description:
Poll an AI Video Analysis job

Returns the current status of an analysis job. When the status is `completed`, the response includes the generated visual transcript file's asset details and delivery URL.
